messages:
Kai: Heads-up — vendor just reported a customs hold in FRA on a 24-unit H100 shipment. 6 units marked DOA, 12 being processed as RMA. Vendor offering partial air replacement for 6 units. This could impact eu-prod clusters by tomorrow — need decision on expedite and who signs cost.

Jess: Can you drop PO# and vendor contact? Also which fleet/pool is impacted (prod/staging)?

Kai: PO 44321-REDWOOD. Vendor = NovaCompute (procurement rep Sophie-NC). Affects prod-gpu-eu-west-1 pool, ~70% utilization right now.

Marco: We're at 92% allocation in eu-west-1 with 10 pending high-priority jobs. If we lose 12 GPUs we'll hit admission control and long queue times. Can we route batch and non-latency workloads to us-west while we top-up?

Amy: tagging procurement — @vendor-rep can you confirm ETA for partial air (overnight vs 48h) and quote? Also please share warehouse manifest for the RMA so customs can pre-clear.

vendor-rep: vendor-rep: we can do partial air for 6 units, ETA door-to-door 36-48h, estimate EUR 14,000 + insurance. RMA created: RMA#NC-7821. We need commercial invoice + HS code to clear customs; we can upload tonight if you confirm. Vendor will cover DOA under warranty (repair or credit).

sre-bot: alert: prod-gpu-eu-west-1 pool available_gpus=18 (threshold 20). If >2 units drop, admission-control will throttle new non-system allocations. Queued jobs: 9. Recommend enable preemptible fallback and migrate batch workloads.

Sam: Quick cost check — loaners vs expedite? Depot can loan up to 4 temporary units for 72h but shipping + setup ~EUR 6k and adds operational risk. Expedite gets 6 air units sooner but at higher up-front cost.

Laura: Procurement ok to approve up to EUR 15k for expedite if vendor provides written confirmation of 36h ETA and AWB. Approval contingent on vendor covering DOA (repair/credit). Also require RCA within 5 business days after delivery.

Kai: Vendor says they'll cover DOA. Need AWB + manifest to push customs clearance. Jess — can you upload manifest and open customs ticket?

Jess: Uploading manifest now. AWB: 1Z999NC0001. Manifest snippet:
```
SKU: H100-40G x6
Serials: H100-ABCD1234..H100-ABCD1239
RMA: NC-7821
```
cc @customs-team

vendor-bot: shipping update: AWB 1Z999NC0001 cleared FRA customs at 2026-03-20T09:22Z, in-transit. Estimated door 36h. Tracking: https://track.novacompute.example/1Z999NC0001

Marco: Routing plan: shift non-latency-critical jobs to us-west for 48h, keep a small canary in eu. I'll update autoscaler policies and enable burst from dedicated pool-3. Ops note: expect transient higher egress and preemption events.

Kai: Confirm chargeback line: expedite cost to infra-provisioning budget? Sam?

Sam: Charge to 'infra-provisioning' for now; finance reconciliation after receipt. Please log expense in Confluence page /finance/infra/expedites-2026 and attach vendor invoice.

Laura: Also require vendor RCA within 5 business days and acceptance of SLA credit if recurrence. If they fail to deliver RCA or credit, we will withhold further expedite approvals.

Kai: Great. Thanks everyone. I'll monitor capacity and post updates when the AWB reaches local depot and when we see available_gpus tick back up. :thumbsup:
